screen.findmyitems.config.title: findmyitems Configuration
screen.findmyitems.config.rescan_interva:
How often, in seconds, to rescan nearby known containers.
0 = disabled. Single-player worlds only.
screen.findmyitems.config.search_distanc:
Maximum distance, in chunks, from the player when rescanning containers.
0 = unlimited. Higher values may affect performance.
screen.findmyitems.config.filter_invento: Show inventory items in the filter bar.
screen.findmyitems.config.filter_contain: Show container items in the filter bar.
screen.findmyitems.config.retrieve_dista:
How far away a container can be and still be retrieved from.
"Normal reach" is the range at which you could right-click it.
Increasing this does not shorten your reach, and unloaded chunks
still cannot be reached into.
screen.findmyitems.config.index_ender.to:
Keep your ender chest contents indexed without a placed ender chest.
Because this is player data, it does not load chunks. This stock is listed
as out of reach until you stand at an ender chest.
